patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Agitated, talking a mile a minute
clinical.quoteLong: I feel INCREDIBLE, I haven't slept in three days and I don't need to — my mind is racing with brilliant plans. My family freaked out and dragged me here. I'm fine, better than fine, I just can't sit still.
clinical.presentationShort: 36yo M with bipolar disorder ? pressured speech, grandiosity, racing thoughts, 3 days without sleep and marked restlessness; not violent, medically stable.
clinical.presentationLong: 36-year-old male with bipolar disorder who has slept very little for three days. He has rapid pressured speech, racing thoughts, grandiose plans, and marked restlessness; he is not violent and has no evident medical instability.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 4: medically stable and low risk; Psych is preferred for a behavioral-health evaluation, and Fast Track is acceptable.
diagnosis.disposition: Psych → calm environment, psychiatric evaluation, mood stabilization; screen for stimulants/organic causes. Behavioral, currently non-dangerous.
diagnosis.why: Pressured speech + no sleep + grandiosity, stable and non-violent → the Psych lane. Escalating agitation/violence would raise acuity.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 36-year-old man, energized and restless, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: leaning forward, mid-gesture, animated and restless. Expression: wired and over-bright. Clearly visible: an animated, gesturing, restless posture. No text, no logos.
